name: mobile_de_ad_chromium
description: MEASURED 2026-09-17 (research/preset_audit_post_merge_2026_09_17.json, n=2 per twin, run 4-wide at the tail of a 108-run sweep): the ad ARRIVED on 2 of 4 runs, one per engine, every field filled and both readings identical (BMW 525, 3750 EUR, 256000 km, EZ 01/2008, 160 kW) -- but BOTH were reported fetch_ok=false with selector_not_found for [data-testid='vip-ad-title'], because Akamai's interstitial reloads into the real page only after the attempt's (shortened) selector deadline, and the settling read then captures the real page the parser fills from. Until that wait is fixed, judge this preset by its data, not by fetch_ok. Of the other two, camoufox run 1 ended on the interstitial and was reported as a block ('Captcha/block detected'), while chromium run 0 was reported as selector_not_found with no status code at all -- so this preset's failures still surface under two different warning strings. The 0 of 6 on 09-11 (below) has no record file and the 09-06 -> 09-11 -> 09-17 swing is exit reputation on the day, not the recipe. Earlier: measured 0 of 6 on 2026-09-11: mobile.de sits behind Akamai Bot Manager, and on the ad page every run of both twins landed on its behavioural interstitial (HTTP 200 from the requested URL, no redirect, 2.5-2.7 KB, no , zero data-testid nodes, `sec-if-cpt-container` + the Akamai logo, ~105 s over three attempts). The search twins passed 7 of 8 in the same hour on the same pool, so this is the ad URL shape being refused rather than the pool being burned. Earlier measurement through the presets as shipped was 1 of 4 on 2026-09-06. Until it is measured passing again, treat this pair as unreliable and prefer mobile_de_search. Whenever the page does arrive every column fills -- the recipe itself has not been shown to be wrong. mobile.de vehicle ad (Germany) by its numeric ad id (`ad_id`, the `id` in /fahrzeuge/details.html?id=…). Selectors anchor on the page's `data-testid` hooks (vip-ad-title, vip-price-label, the vip-key-features-list-item-* facts, the technical-data <dt data-testid="color-item"> + <dd> pair, vip-key-features-seller-seller-name, vip-vehicle-description-text) because the class names are build hashes; self_heal is on. `price` parses "3.750 €" as 3750.0; `mileage_km` and `power_kw` are integers read out of "256.000 km" and "160 kW (218 PS)"; the other facts are the printed strings; `description` turns the seller's `<br>` line breaks and `<li>` items into spaces. There is no <h1> on this page -- the title is the vip-ad-title node (rendered twice, header and sticky bar; the first is read). Akamai Bot Manager fronts the site and only a warmup of https://www.mobile.de/ gets past it, as on mobile_de_search (both twins carry it). ENGINE: Chromium (real Chrome, headful). MEASURED 2026-09-06 through the preset as shipped, LOW: 1 of 4 runs returned the ad (every field filled); the others ended on the Akamai shell, one with a captcha page on the last attempt. The two raw probes with the www.mobile.de warmup earlier that day passed 2 of 2 (stealth on and off), so this is a per-attempt lottery that got worse as the day's probing went on (research/preset_audit_new_bases_2026_09_06.json + …_seq_…). timeout_ms 31000 (per-phase, with the 10 s warmup dwell; see test_builtin_timeout_fits_the_first_attempt). RE-MEASURED 2026-09-11 through the preset as shipped: 0 of 6 (three runs per twin), every one on the Akamai behavioural interstitial. That page is now recognised as a block by `looks_like_captcha_or_block`; before this it was reported as `selector_not_found`, i.e. as a broken recipe.
